entities.summary: The Anterior Lê dynasty, alternatively known as the Former Lê dynasty in historiography, was a dynasty of Vietnam that ruled Đại Cồ Việt from 980 to 1009. It followed the Đinh dynasty and was succeeded by the Lý dynasty. It comprised the reigns of three emperors.
